SELECT V.ID, V.VEHICLE_PLATE, V.VEHICLE_BRAND, V.VEHICLE_COLOR, V.AREA_NAME, V.EVENT_TYPE, V.SNAP_TIME, V.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, V.DRIVER_NAME, V.DRIVER_PHONE, V.DRIVER_TYPE, V.CREATE_TIME, SV.COMPANY FROM SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE V LEFT JOIN SMT_VISITOR SV ON V.DRIVER_ID = SV. ID
V.ID=#{query.id}

SELECT V.ID, V.VEHICLE_PLATE, V.VEHICLE_BRAND, V.VEHICLE_COLOR, V.AREA_NAME, V.EVENT_TYPE, V.SNAP_TIME, V.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, V.DRIVER_NAME, V.DRIVER_PHONE, V.DRIVER_TYPE, V.CREATE_TIME, SV.COMPANY FROM SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE V LEFT JOIN SMT_ADMITTANCE_VEHICLE SAV ON V.DRIVER_ID = SAV.ID LEFT JOIN SMT_VISITOR SV ON SAV.VISITOR_ID = SV.ID
V.ID=#{query.id}

SELECT V.ID, V.VEHICLE_PLATE, V.VEHICLE_BRAND, V.VEHICLE_COLOR, V.AREA_NAME, V.EVENT_TYPE, V.SNAP_TIME, V.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, V.DRIVER_NAME, V.DRIVER_PHONE, V.CREATE_TIME, V.DRIVER_TYPE FROM SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE V
V.ID=#{query.id}

SELECT V. ID, V.VEHICLE_PLATE, V.VEHICLE_BRAND, V.VEHICLE_COLOR, V.AREA_NAME, V.EVENT_TYPE, V.SNAP_TIME, V.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, V.DRIVER_NAME, V.DRIVER_PHONE, V.DRIVER_TYPE, SF.BADGE, SF.COMP_NAME, SF.DEP_NAME, SF.JOB_NAME, SF.JCHE_NAME FROM SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE V LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF SF ON V.DRIVER_ID = SF. ID
V.ID=#{query.id}

SELECT SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE. ID, SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.VEHICLE_PLATE, SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.EVENT_TYPE, SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.SNAP_TIME, SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.DRIVER_NAME, SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.DRIVER_PHONE, SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.PARK_ID FROM SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.DEVICE_ID IN( SELECT SMT_DEVICE."ID" FROM SMT_DEVICE WHERE SMT_DEVICE.DEVICE_SUBTYPE IN ( SELECT SMT_PARKING."ID" FROM SMT_PARKING ) )
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.PARK_ID = #{query.parkId}
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.PARK_ID IN
#{tempId}
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.VEHICLE_PLATE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.vehiclePlate}),'%')
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.DRIVER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.driverName}),'%')
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.SNAP_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{query.startTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.SNAP_TIME < TO_DATE(#{query.endTime}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + 1
AND SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.EVENT_TYPE = #{query.eventType}
ORDER BY SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE.SNAP_TIME DESC

SELECT TRUNC ( TO_NUMBER ( TO_CHAR (SSV.SNAP_TIME, 'hh24') ) / 4 ) AS ORDER_INDEX, COUNT (*) AS TOTAL, SSV.EVENT_TYPE FROM SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE SSV WHERE
PARK_ID=#{parkId} and
SSV.SNAP_TIME > TRUNC (SYSDATE) AND SSV.DEVICE_ID NOT IN ( SELECT SD."ID" FROM SMT_DEVICE SD WHERE SD.DEVICE_SUBTYPE IN ( SELECT SP. ID FROM SMT_PARKING SP ) ) GROUP BY TRUNC ( TO_NUMBER ( TO_CHAR (SSV.SNAP_TIME, 'hh24') ) / 4 ), SSV.EVENT_TYPE ORDER BY SSV.EVENT_TYPE, ORDER_INDEX
